responsibility: Implements SARIF v2.1.0 output for diagnostics by building a full SARIF run from emitted GCC diagnostics. This file owns the SARIF-specific builder classes and callback replacements that translate diagnostic kinds, rich locations, logical locations, paths/code flows, fix-it hints, tool/version/plugin metadata, CWE/rule metadata, and ICE notifications into SARIF result, invocation, artifact, and related JSON objects, finally writing either stderr output or a .sarif file.
